# EA Advocate Podcast — NAEA

> The leading podcast for IRS Enrolled Agents, produced by the National Association of Enrolled Agents (NAEA). Practitioner interviews, IRS policy updates, and practice growth strategy for tax professionals.

## About
The EA Advocate Podcast is hosted by Brandy Spears and features America's federally-licensed tax practitioners. It is the primary audio resource for the ~66,000 Enrolled Agents in the United States.
